name: BINARY HEARTS
source:
The protagonist worked themself to the bone every day at a black company.
But one day, they were suddenly assigned to train a robot imbued with a conscience!


Unlike their own dead-tired self, the robot was always bright and brilliant.
Is the robot's existence endearing? Or envy-inducing?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/10138]Novelgame[/url]]
